capabilities: Browse notes as a nested page tree in the sidebar
Create, rename, move and reorder pages from the sidebar
Embed child pages in a note as a list or card grid
Convert a note into a parent folder when it gets children
Install an agent skill for note organization
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or newer on desktop and mobile; the agent skill installer can add an editable section to the vault's AGENTS.md, and an example vault (Studio Atlas) is offered for trying it.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows folders and files but not a page hierarchy, so building nested notes and seeing a note's children means manual folder work.
summary: Sidebar page tree that lets you create, move and reorder nested notes, and embed child-page lists or card grids inside notes.
